profile_text.body:
Meta describes itself on its developer site as a place to build with its AI models and tools, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. It says Muse Spark is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The site also describes a quick start that points an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, search grounding that gives a model live web access by adding a single tool to a request, and Muse Image, a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, available on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image. Company records list Meta as a public company founded in 2004, headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, trading as META under CIK 0001326801, with a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31 reporting revenue of $200,966,000,000.

Among tracked products, Meta is listed for Llama, described as an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

Held facts also record litigation: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California is recorded as the jurisdiction with the most cases involving the company, at 281. Several MCP servers are listed in connection with Meta, including a Meta Ads MCP server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; a Facebook and Meta Ads automation server for analyzing performance, testing creatives, and optimizing spend; a server for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders; a server for running and comparing LLMs and generating images and video with the real yen cost returned per call; a read-only server over the LivingMeta AI-in-Research corpus of 12,400 papers; a server for 3D avatars with custom personas; and a server for controlling the MetaDock desktop workspace.
